mapper.select: SELECT um_user_code, um_user_name, um_oauth_type, um_oauth_subject, um_reg_date FROM "TBL_USER_MAS" WHERE um_oauth_type = #{oauthType} AND um_oauth_subject = #{oauthSubject}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "TBL_USER_MAS" (um_user_name, um_oauth_type, um_oauth_subject) VALUES (#{userName}, #{oauthType}, #{oauthSubject}) ON CONFLICT (um_oauth_type, um_oauth_subject) DO NOTHING
